description: A man in a dark early-19th-century suit with a white cravat stands on a raised wooden platform, hand resting on a book on a stand, while an older man in a black robe with white hair raises his other hand. Behind them, a row of older men in period coats stands on the platform beside a red brick building with multi-pane windows. A large crowd of men in top hats and women in bonnets fills the open ground under a pale sky with clouds.
